name: kirchi
description: Simulador de circuitos libre y sin conexión

scripts.dev: npm run build:engine && node scripts/electron-vite.mjs dev
scripts.build: npm run build:engine && node scripts/electron-vite.mjs build
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.test: vitest run && vitest run -c vitest.componentes.config.ts && vitest run -c vitest.rendimiento.config.ts
scripts.dist: npm run build && node scripts/preparar-ngspice.mjs && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:todo: npm run build && node scripts/preparar-ngspice.mjs && node scripts/preparar-licencias-electron.mjs && electron-builder --win --mac --linux
scripts.dist:tienda: npm run build && node scripts/preparar-ngspice.mjs && electron-builder --win appx --publish never
scripts.dist:dir: npm run build && node scripts/preparar-ngspice.mjs && electron-builder --win --dir
